card.name: The word duration and the 'of' after it
card.fires_on: The word "duration" in phrases like "for a duration of", and the word "of" right after "the duration" or "a duration". Mostly in dosing-length statements.

modes.label: duration itself
modes.description: The word duration after "for a" or "for the", before "of" and a length of time.
modes.example: Acquire images for a single bed position centered on the brain for a<< duration>> of 20 minutes.

modes.label: of after duration
modes.description: The word "of" following "for the duration", before a therapy or time span.
modes.example: tests are recommended every six months for the duration<< of>> therapy.

card.writes: It seems to suppress repeating the word duration and its variants, leaving the next word open.
card.plain: It marks the phrase "for the duration of" that says how long a treatment or condition lasts.
